Ana: Customer asked for an "audit kit" for model rollouts: per-model cost delta, error-delta timeline, and a trace link for disputed requests. Need scope options for next sprint.
Ben: Quick reality check: model_variant at request boundary = easy. Per-token attribution across batching/cache = hard.
Priya: PM acceptance criteria draft: dashboard card (last7/30d cost+error delta), click-to-filter traces with hashed_tenant+model_variant, CSV export, and per-tenant sampling toggle.
Liam: Engineering options: MVP = aggregated deltas + trace-filter link (no token mapping). HYBRID = propagate hashed_tenant & model_variant, sampled token timelines for flagged tenants. FULL = exact per-token mapping across reroutes & dedicated pools.
Sora: Risk callout: FULL touches hot path; naive token spans will add tail latency. Recommend default sampling 1-3% with per-tenant override.
Ana: Can we get perf numbers before Wed? Ben, can your team run a small bench for token-span overhead (perf job)?
Ben: Will queue perf-12021, ETA ~48h. I'll include tail latency buckets and memory delta.
Priya: GTM note: Sales can upsell HYBRID as "audit add-on" if we can promise sampled forensic traces for disputes. Add that to decision doc.
canary-bot: canary window reserved: 2026-06-02T09:00:00Z - 2026-06-02T11:00:00Z (FYI).
Ana: OK owners: Priya (doc + acceptance), Ben (runtime scope + perf), Liam (rollout toggles & canary plan). Meeting Thu 9am PT to pick option.
